name: FibreOrderToActivationTracker
tagline: Every fibre order from placed to billing – with jeopardy, fallout and install capacity in one drop-in app.
description: A complete order-to-activation module for broadband and fibre operators in Power Apps and Power Pages. It covers the milestone pipeline with business rules, the jeopardy queue, the install calendar against capacity, an orders grid with bulk actions, the order journey and create / edit with validation, and it works on demo data the moment it is dropped.
features: Milestone rules with required data per step
Jeopardy detection: committed date, stage SLA, missed appointment, router not shipped, fallout
Bulk move, assign technician, hold, CSV export
KPIs: order-to-activate days, right first time, MRR waiting to bill
Phone layout with bottom view bar
